comparison.matched_total_evaluation_budget: Paper Figure 4 compares fixed strategies against EvoX initialized from the same named strategies over a 100-iteration Heilbronn Triangle run; paper-wide open-framework evaluation budget is 100 iterations.
comparison.baseline_intervention: Continue under a fixed search strategy (Beam Search, Best-of-N, Top-K, or MAP-Elites).
comparison.treatment_intervention: Continue under the same initialization but allow stagnation-triggered search-strategy evolution.
comparison.result_scope: On Heilbronn Triangle, the paper reports fixed strategies saturating while EvoX initialized from each continues improving. It additionally reports GEPA plateauing near 0.0323 around 20 iterations while EvoX reaches 0.0339 under GPT-5 cost-quality analysis. These are optimization-surface results, not untouched outer-test generalization results.
comparison.material_closure: This is a stronger same-system, same-task, fixed-evaluation-budget comparison than previously catalogued scheduled-meta-policy evidence. It isolates adaptive strategy evolution versus continuing with a fixed strategy more directly, but still does not isolate Stop vs Widen vs Reopen.

trigger_and_mechanism.paper_algorithm: After a window W of solution evaluations, compute best-score improvement Delta; if Delta < tau, generate a new search strategy conditioned on strategy history and current population state. Paper experiments use W = 10% of the total iteration budget.
trigger_and_mechanism.current_public_implementation: At audited revision, track best-score improvement per solution iteration; if improvement <= 0.01 for switch_interval consecutive iterations (default ~10% of total), generate a new EvolvedProgramDatabase, structurally/functionally validate it, migrate the existing population, and immediately hot-swap it into the live search.
trigger_and_mechanism.promotion_boundary: The newly generated search strategy is not behaviorally compared against the incumbent before live use. Structural/functional validity is sufficient for the live switch; its downstream progress is scored only after deployment. Runtime database failure can restore the prior strategy. Therefore current public code has strategy validity/fallback, not candidate-incumbent behavioral promotion evidence.

evaluation_hygiene.selection_surface: The downstream task objective itself drives solution selection, stagnation detection, search-strategy scoring, and final best-solution reporting.

scope_nonclaims: Do not treat Figure 4 as a Stop-vs-Reopen causal comparison; the fixed baseline keeps spending the same solution-evaluation budget under the old policy.
Do not infer that strategy rewriting itself is solely causal if meta-strategy generation has extra LLM cost not counted in the solution-evaluation budget.
Do not treat final optimization score as held-out generalization evidence.
Do not retroactively assume the audited current public controller is byte-identical to the paper-run executable.
Do not infer statistical safety from the structural/functional search-strategy validator.
next_action: Recover the exact EvoX Figure-4 run config/logs or paper-bound executable to verify generator model, seeds, strategy-generation cost accounting, strategy chronology, and whether fixed-vs-evolving curves are fully matched beyond the 100 solution-evaluation budget. In parallel continue searching for a same-system Stop-vs-Widen-vs-Reopen comparison with separate promotion evidence and an untouched outer test; audit any candidate for candidate-local anytime-valid acceptance and restart-durable cross-proposal spending.
